cohort: Pregnant women at 11-13+6 weeks gestation who received routine care at an obstetrics and gynecology clinic
finding: Lower VI, FI, and VFI measured by 3D-PDU in the first trimester were associated with a higher risk of FGR and adverse perinatal outcomes.
